description: Generate a Jest test suite: real assertions from {input, expected|throws} cases, pending it.todo for described cases, async support, module mocks

mockDeps.description: Module paths to replace with automatic mocks

modulePath.description: Import path of the module under test, e.g. ./src/orders/createOrder

testCases.description: Test cases. Either a description string (generated as a pending test) or {name, input: [args...], expected} / {name, input, throws: true | "message"} for a real assertion.

throws.description: true, or a substring of the expected error message

name: generate_jest_test
